excerpt.zh: 我们的能量赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的能量赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的能量币赤字已经失控！[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]要求我们采取有效措施控制事态，否则将会在数月之后大幅削减开支。
texts.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] demands that we take drastic action to take hold of the situation, failing which severe cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months.

texts.zh: 我们的能量币赤字已经失控！我们的资源分配子个体面对我们补给线健康度的读数时愈发地焦虑不安了。它们预计，如果无法采取有效行动，在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
texts.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! Our resource distribution drones are increasingly agitated at the readings they measure on the health of our supply lines. They forecast that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

label.zh: 我们可以从支持者那里借一点。
label.en: We can borrow from our supporters.
Everything is going according to plan.

texts.zh: 我们没能避免破产。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能拖欠债务并大幅削减开支。
texts.en: We have failed to stave off bankruptcy. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to default on our debts and make sharp cutbacks to our expenditures.

texts.zh: 我们没能平衡收支。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
texts.en: We have failed to rebalance our expenditures. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to enforce large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution systems.

texts.zh: 依据我们的谍报信息，[kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName]，目前正遭遭受到能源短缺的困扰。我们送他们的万华镜似乎正是这一经济困境的主要起因。
texts.en: According to our espionage reports, [kaleidoscope_new_owner.GetName], is currently suffering from an energy shortage. The Kaleidoscope we gifted them seems to be the main cause of their economic troubles.
